title: CBDCs and the Golden Image
summary: Nebuchadnezzar's financial plan was to make Babylon endure forever, but God has a better plan which He reveals from heaven. The tabernacle financed by ancient Israel after the exodus was constructed using the borrowed Egyptian resources taken into custody and improved by Israelite time and energy. Bitcoin does the same thing today! This episode also explores the role of King Charles in modern finance and how the mark of the beast will manifest.
